---
title: "PFS-like survival from first cfDNA draw by first TFx among patients with TFx ≥ 3%"
output: html_document
date: "2026-07-01"
---
# ============================================================
# PFS Analysis 1
# First available cfDNA blood draw TFx vs time to next progression/death
# ============================================================
#
# Endpoint:
#   PFS-like interval from cfDNA blood draw to next documented progression or death.
#
# Primary analysis:
#   One row per patient = first available cfDNA blood draw
#
# Predictor:
#   TFx at first available blood draw ≥ 3%
#
# Outcome:
#   PFS_time_from_draw = next progression/death/censor day - blood draw day
#
# Event:
#   1 = progression or death after blood draw
#   0 = censored at OS/follow-up day
#
# Important:
#   This is a cfDNA-indexed PFS-like endpoint, not trial-defined RECIST PFS.
# ============================================================
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------
# Paths
# ----------------------------
pfs1_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/Survival/PFS_Analysis1_first_available_draw"

input_file <- file.path(
  pfs1_dir,
  "PFS1_first_available_draw_per_patient.csv"
)

out_png <- file.path(
  pfs1_dir,
  "PFS1_KM_first_draw_TFx_months_with_risktable.png"
)

out_pdf <- file.path(
  pfs1_dir,
  "PFS1_KM_first_draw_TFx_months_with_risktable.pdf"
)

summary_out <- file.path(
  pfs1_dir,
  "PFS1_KM_summary.csv"
)

cat("Input file:\n", input_file, "\n\n")

# ----------------------------
# Read data
# ----------------------------
df <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Rows in input:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Columns:\n")
print(colnames(df))

# ----------------------------
# Convert days to months
# Keep only patients with first_TFx >= 3%
# Then recalculate median cutpoint within this filtered cohort
# ----------------------------
min_first_TFx_cutoff <- 3

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    first_TFx = as.numeric(first_TFx),
    PFS_time_from_first_draw = as.numeric(PFS_time_from_first_draw),
    PFS_time_from_first_draw_months = PFS_time_from_first_draw / days_per_month,
    PFS_event_from_first_draw = as.numeric(PFS_event_from_first_draw)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(first_TFx),
    first_TFx >= min_first_TFx_cutoff,
    !is.na(PFS_time_from_first_draw_months),
    !is.na(PFS_event_from_first_draw),
    PFS_time_from_first_draw_months > 0
  )

cat("\nApplied first_TFx cutoff: >= ", min_first_TFx_cutoff, "%\n", sep = "")
cat("Patients after first_TFx cutoff:", nrow(df), "\n")

# Recalculate median TFx only among patients with first_TFx >= 3%
median_tfx_cut <- median(df$first_TFx, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("\nMedian first TFx cutpoint after applying >=3% filter:", 
    round(median_tfx_cut, 4), "%\n")

# ----------------------------
# Low/High TFx groups
# ----------------------------
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    first_TFx_group_clean = case_when(
      first_TFx < median_tfx_cut ~ "Low first TFx",
      first_TFx >= median_tfx_cut ~ "High first TFx",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    first_TFx_group_clean = factor(
      first_TFx_group_clean,
      levels = c("Low first TFx", "High first TFx")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(first_TFx_group_clean))

cat("\n========== PFS1 plot cohort ==========\n")
cat("Patients:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Events:", sum(df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Censored:", sum(df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

cat("Group counts:\n")
print(table(df$first_TFx_group_clean))

cat("\nEvents by group:\n")
print(table(df$first_TFx_group_clean, df$PFS_event_from_first_draw))

# ----------------------------
# Survival fit
# ----------------------------
fit <- survfit(
  Surv(PFS_time_from_first_draw_months, PFS_event_from_first_draw) ~ first_TFx_group_clean,
  data = df
)
# ----------------------------
# Median PFS-like survival from KM fit
# ----------------------------
median_pfs_df <- survminer::surv_median(fit) %>%
  mutate(
    first_TFx_group_clean = gsub(
      "^first_TFx_group_clean=",
      "",
      strata
    ),
    first_TFx_group_clean = factor(
      first_TFx_group_clean,
      levels = levels(df$first_TFx_group_clean)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    first_TFx_group_clean,
    median_survival_months = median,
    median_survival_lower_95CI = lower,
    median_survival_upper_95CI = upper
  )

cat("\nMedian PFS-like survival by group from KM fit:\n")
print(median_pfs_df)

# ----------------------------
# Log-rank p-value calculated from data
# ----------------------------
lr <- survdiff(
  Surv(PFS_time_from_first_draw_months, PFS_event_from_first_draw) ~ first_TFx_group_clean,
  data = df
)

p_val <- 1 - pchisq(lr$chisq, df = length(lr$n) - 1)

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("p = NA")
  } else if (p < 0.001) {
    return("p < 0.001")
  } else {
    return(paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  }
}

p_label <- format_p(p_val)

annot_text <- paste0(
  "Log-rank ", p_label, "\n",
  "Median TFx cutpoint = ", round(median_tfx_cut, 2), "%"
)

cat("\nLog-rank chi-square:", lr$chisq, "\n")
cat("Log-rank p-value:", p_val, "\n")
cat("Plot annotation:\n", annot_text, "\n\n")

# ----------------------------
# KM summary with median PFS-like survival months
# ----------------------------
km_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(first_TFx_group_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    n_patients = n(),
    n_events = sum(PFS_event_from_first_draw == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_censored = sum(PFS_event_from_first_draw == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_first_TFx = median(first_TFx, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_first_TFx = min(first_TFx, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_first_TFx = max(first_TFx, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    median_pfs_df,
    by = "first_TFx_group_clean"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    overall_median_TFx_cutpoint = median_tfx_cut,
    logrank_chi_square = lr$chisq,
    logrank_p_value = p_val
  )

write_csv(km_summary, summary_out)

cat("\nKM summary with median PFS-like survival saved:\n", summary_out, "\n")
print(km_summary)

# ----------------------------
# Axis settings
# ----------------------------
x_max <- 72
break_by <- 12

annot_x <- x_max * 0.94
annot_y <- 0.97

# ----------------------------
# Legend labels
# ----------------------------
low_n <- sum(df$first_TFx_group_clean == "Low first TFx")
low_events <- sum(
  df$first_TFx_group_clean == "Low first TFx" &
    df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 1
)

high_n <- sum(df$first_TFx_group_clean == "High first TFx")
high_events <- sum(
  df$first_TFx_group_clean == "High first TFx" &
    df$PFS_event_from_first_draw == 1
)

legend_labs <- c(
  paste0("Low first TFx (n=", low_n, ", events=", low_events, ")"),
  paste0("High first TFx (n=", high_n, ", events=", high_events, ")")
)

# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------
p <- ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  data = df,
  
  # Main KM curve
  conf.int = TRUE,
  conf.int.alpha = 0.22,
  censor = TRUE,
  censor.shape = 3,
  censor.size = 3.2,
  size = 1.15,
  
  # Single bottom number-at-risk table
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.title = "Number at risk",
  risk.table.height = 0.24,
  risk.table.y.text = TRUE,
  risk.table.y.text.col = TRUE,
  tables.theme = theme_cleantable(base_size = 12),
  
  # Labels
  title = "PFS-like survival from first cfDNA draw by first TFx",
  xlab = "Time from first cfDNA blood draw to progression/death/censor (months)",
  ylab = "Progression/death-free probability",
  
  # Axis
  break.time.by = break_by,
  xlim = c(0, x_max),
  ylim = c(0, 1.05),
  
  # Legend
  legend.title = "First-draw TFx group",
  legend.labs = legend_labs,
  legend = "top",
  
  # Colors
  palette = c("#1E88E5", "#E74C3C"),
  
  # Manual p-value annotation added below
  pval = FALSE,
  
  # Base theme
  ggtheme = theme_classic(base_size = 15)
)

# ----------------------------
# Clean main KM plot
# ----------------------------
p$plot <- p$plot +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = annot_x,
    y = annot_y,
    label = annot_text,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 4.4,
    label.size = 0.25,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 18,
      margin = margin(t = 10, b = 18)
    ),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.box.margin = margin(b = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    
    # Locked style: no grid lines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 18, r = 15, b = 5, l = 15)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Clean bottom number-at-risk table
# Do not set axis.text.y because survminer uses colored y labels
# ----------------------------
p$table <- p$table +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    
    # Locked style: no grid lines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 15, b = 8, l = 15)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Save outputs
# ----------------------------
png(
  filename = out_png,
  width = 11,
  height = 8.3,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)
print(p)
dev.off()

pdf(
  file = out_pdf,
  width = 11,
  height = 8.3
)
print(p)
dev.off()

cat("\nSaved publication-style PFS1 KM plot:\n")
cat(out_png, "\n")
cat(out_pdf, "\n")

cat("\nSaved summary table:\n")
cat(summary_out, "\n")
```
